note: Hand-set confidence CLASSES for standard fusion patterns, from general GPU-kernel knowledge only. NO number here comes from any run, sweep or experiment on these problems. Patterns are L1 stage-family keys (graph_priors.fusion_keys[1]): conv/dwconv/gconv, bn, ln, gn, linear, gemm, ewise (binary add/mul/...), sewise (scalar ops), relu etc. are their own names. Anything not listed is class 'unknown' (decided by measurement). Only class 'high' is eligible for pre-apply (elementwise-tail chains: the fused kernel reads and writes the same bytes once and cannot be slower than the chain); 'medium' (conv/GEMM heads with an epilogue) goes through the early rung decisions; structural kinds (attention, layout fold, siblings, split) are always 'unknown'.

high.why: elementwise tail only: saves the intermediate round trips and launches, no change of the heavy op

medium.why: heavy head (conv / GEMM) with an elementwise epilogue: usually a gain, but the fused head can lose the tuned kernel
